faq_heading: Homes near Boundary Park Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Boundary Park Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Boundary Park Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Boundary Park Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Boundary Park Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 99 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,380,000, townhomes $750,000, condos $475,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Boundary Park Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Boundary Park Elementary the median was 31 days on the market, closing at 97.3% of the list price, with 10% of sales above the list price for the 99 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Boundary Park Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Beaver Creek Elementary (0.4 km north), J T Brown Elementary (0.7 km south-east) and Tamanawis Secondary (0.9 km north-east).

Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Boundary Park Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Boundary Park Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Boundary Park Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Boundary Park Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 99 homes sold within 1 km of Boundary Park Elementary: 35 houses, 54 townhomes and 9 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $750,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Boundary Park Elementary

26 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Boundary Park Elementary in a straight line (20 elementary, 5 secondary, 1 other; 4 independent). The closest is Beaver Creek Elementary, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is Westerman Elementary, 2.7 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Tamanawis Secondary (0.9 km); the nearest independent school is Khalsa School Newton (1.4 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary (1.9 km). Other elementary schools close by: Beaver Creek Elementary (0.4 km north), J T Brown Elementary (0.7 km south-east), Panorama Park Elementary (1.1 km east), Pinewood Elementary (1.1 km west), Khalsa School Newton (1.4 km north). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Beaver Creek Elementary, 0.4 km north of Boundary Park Elementary.
